blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Following a first-game disqualification, Sibol’s Pokémon Unite squad showed what it was capable of, taking the Pool A top seed and advancing to the Asian Games 2026 esports quarterfinals Saturday at Aichi Sky Expo. Team Philippines and Kazakhstan forfeited their opening match over uniform violations. Sibol responded by winning two must-win games to keep its medal hopes alive, beating Chinese Taipei, 2-0, before dispatching Malaysia by the same score to finish the pool stage 2-1. “Unfortunately, that’s what happened yesterday.
